mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market overheating, triggering Fed rate hikes that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >50k and UNRATE decreases by >0.1pp, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early-cycle expansions when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates labor market tightness supporting corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by >5% and RSAFS increases by >0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 310), a decline in the consumer price index signals disinflation, reducing rate hike risks and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 310 and declines from prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
